title: CraftStrippedLogs
description: A simple datapack that lets you craft stripped logs from regular logs.
body:
A simple datapack that lets you craft stripped logs from regular logs.

Recipes:
- 2 Oak Logs → 2 Stripped Oak Logs
- 2 Spruce Logs → 2 Stripped Spruce Logs
- 2 Birch Logs → 2 Stripped Birch Logs
- 2 Jungle Logs → 2 Stripped Jungle Logs
- 2 Acacia Logs → 2 Stripped Acacia Logs
- 2 Dark Oak Logs → 2 Stripped Dark Oak Logs
- 2 Mangrove Logs → 2 Stripped Mangrove Logs
- 2 Cherry Logs → 2 Stripped Cherry Logs
- 2 Pale Oak Logs → 2 Stripped Pale Oak Logs
- 2 Crimson Stems → 2 Stripped Crimson Stems
- 2 Warped Stems → 2 Stripped Warped Stems

Works in existing worlds.
No mods required.
